free_tier.stated: 'MorphoSource is able to subsidize or support free contribution of data for most users with 100GB or less.' 100 GB–1 TB is case-by-case (may be fully free); >1 TB is $3.47/GB + $30.
free_tier.notes: the headline offer as the seed recorded it; the binding constraint is in limits[]

per_object_cap.stated: no per-object cap was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that no cap exists
per_object_cap.notes: extraction found no per-object clause; some of these providers meter on object count rather than bytes, and some state no cap

retention.stated: no retention statement was extracted from the seed's quota and limits prose; absence here is a gap in this conversion, not a vendor claim that retention is unlimited
retention.notes: extraction found no retention clause; the seed's limits text may still state one, see extras.limits_verbatim

egress.terms: 'users are never charged for data consumption. Whether that means viewing or downloading data, there are no costs associated with using data.'

tooling: Web upload + batch submission tooling (Duke wiki 'Batch Submission'); no public upload API. Read side serves media files over HTTPS per-record.
chaining: Per-user total contribution is tracked ('these data size limits apply to the total contribution of data by a user or institution'), so 100 GB is per identity, not per record — multiple contributor identities multiply it. Read side free regardless.
limits_note: per-object-cap: none published; the binding cap is a per-identity total of 100 GB free (100 GB–1 TB discretionary). Retention: 'retain all data ... for as long as MorphoSource continues to exist' — no expiry but no endowment either. Contributor status is application-gated.
